items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: don't mess with that Slivovitch... It's made out of prunes and it's strong

ctx.x: Yes. We met Louis, I met Louis, where was it, somewhere I saw Louis over there and he says, Buck, don't mess with that Slivovitch. (LAUGHTER). So that's the first thing I wanted to do.

It's made out of prunes and it's strong, you know. And so me and Joe Turner we got in Yugoslavia, got comfortably seated in a bar and we proce ded to take a drink of Slivovitch. And it just went down like apple juice. It went down, so we said, Slivovitch isn't, it isn't nothing.
